children: AEVEX reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $189.7 million, up 56.5% year over year, and a net loss of $16.8 million compared with net income of $9.9 million a year earlier. Adjusted EBITDA increased to $30.8 million from $17.8 million. The company raised its full-year 2026 revenue and Adjusted EBITDA outlook.
Financial Highlights
Revenue:
$189.7 million, compared with $121.2 million in the third quarter of 2025.
Gross profit:
$54.7 million, compared with $30.3 million a year earlier.
Operating income:
$12.9 million, compared with $11.5 million in the third quarter of 2025.
Net result:

Net loss of $16.8 million, versus net income of $9.9 million; net loss attributable to AEVEX was $23.9 million. Diluted loss per share was $0.40 for the period following the organizational transactions.
Adjusted EBITDA and outlook:
Third-quarter Adjusted EBITDA was $30.8 million, with a 16.2% margin. For full-year 2026, AEVEX expects revenue of $820 million to $840 million and Adjusted EBITDA of $128 million to $132 million.
Business Highlights
AEVEX completed its acquisition of BlackSea Technologies on September 8, expanding its capabilities across air, surface and subsea domains and adding Maritime Systems as a third reportable segment.
Airborne Systems’ growth was driven by higher demand for unmanned aerial systems products and support services.
BlackSea’s addition established the Maritime Systems segment, while AEVEX recast prior-period segment disclosures to align with its new three-segment structure.
Global Solutions experienced lower activity, primarily in aircraft modifications and testing products.

The company cited demand for autonomous systems and its funded backlog, contract ceiling and pipeline as supports for its growth outlook and plans to scale production and broaden its customer and mission reach.
